answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, re-queued for a second panel. What survives to the umber is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Each submission hangs on the meadow of a task receipt, and the reef is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
